archetypes.name: dyn-baseline-contract
archetypes.rationale: Baseline semantics are the main fail-closed surface for the new renderer ratchet.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the renderer golden-test lint and baseline regeneration path. Focus on malformed rows, stale rows, duplicate identities, and whether --write preserves existing reasons while refusing new unreasoned findings. Check that the committed baseline matches the live predicate and does not silently widen. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
